news.headline: Sequel.io Raises $15M to Build a New Category in Video-Driven Audience Intelligence
news.summary: Sequel.io, a video-driven audience intelligence and activation platform, today announced $15 million in funding led by Sorenson Capital, bringing total funding to approximately $26 million. New investors in the round include High Alpha, Album VC and Webflow Ventures, with additional participation from existing investors Javelin Venture Partners, Struck Capital, Alumni Ventures and Social Leverage.
